title: Big Five personality profile
subtitle: Five traits, without labels
description: These 50 statements invite reflection on five broad traits: extraversion (sociability), agreeableness, conscientiousness, emotional stability, and openness to experience.
algorithm: Rate how well each statement describes your usual behavior.
Separate scores show your responses on each scale; they are not norms or grades.
Preferences vary by situation. This is for reflection, not diagnosis.
comment: Self-reflection using the 50-item public-domain IPIP representation of Goldberg’s Big Five markers (1992). Not a clinical assessment or a fixed label.
questions: Am the life of the party.
Am relaxed most of the time.
Am not interested in abstract ideas.
Am not interested in other people's problems.
Often forget to put things back in their proper place.
Do not have a good imagination.
Talk to a lot of different people at parties.
Am not really interested in others.
Don't like to draw attention to myself.
Don't mind being the center of attention.
